variety.label: Modern Standard Georgian
variety.policyNoteEnglish: Twenty-one common lexemes with explicit six-person paradigms. Four experiencer/possession verbs and exceptional know teach present only; sixteen verbs teach present, future and completed past. The fixed context selects the object agreement. Aorist subject case is authored by verb class. No universal conjugator or exhaustive screeve coverage is claimed.

review.noteEnglish: Original Modern Standard Georgian teaching examples authored and self-reviewed by AI. Independent native Georgian review remains pending. Mkhedruli is the teaching script; no approved pronunciation or audio is claimed. Verb vocabulary uses masdars (verbal nouns), including explicitly labelled practical verb phrases, rather than claiming Georgian has English-style infinitives.
